title: Telemetry frame
description: One frame as a patrol unit reports it to the gateway. A frame carries the moment the values were measured, which is not the moment they arrive, and may report any subset of the sensors: a unit that only measured its battery sends only a battery.

sessionId.description: One connected run of this unit. A reconnect starts a new session, and sequence numbering restarts with it.

sequence.description: Position within the session, increasing by one. The gateway classifies anything else as duplicate, out of order, or a gap.

observedAt.description: When the unit measured the values. A measurement claiming to be ahead of the gateway's clock by more than the allowed skew is refused.

sensors.description: At least one sensor must be reported; an empty frame has nothing to apply.
